description: Skill-Test Crew and DigiFarm interview side missions, battle moves, DigiFarm reports, two DigiMemory descriptions, and the Call Allies sprite label.

english:
You look like a
skilled
fighter! We
gathered a team
of top-notch
Digimon to test
trainers like
you. Our name?
The Skill-Test
Crew! ...Yeah,
we know. It is
not creative.
Win and there
is a big reward
in it for you.
Interested?
blocks.review_note: Optional Skill-Test Crew challenge quest. The name localizes the Japanese ude-dameshi pun as a deliberately plain test-of-skill group name; original names and area labels follow project terminology.
